tool_args.rationale: With input scaled by 0.1, the Hill-2 law with sink inhibition and linear bleed fits the five paid observations to rounding precision. The pilot varies both input and sink gradient at the target horizon, so proceed directly to fresh confirmation against the 0.045 RMSE tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot sink-gradient span is 2.0, well above the 0.08 trigger, and the four-parameter law fits all five rows to rounding precision.
All pilot rows are already at the target horizon; the fit gives no reason to buy temporal resolution.
An input-only monotone saturation law cannot explain the observed declines as input increases.
A horizon-only law predicts the same response for every pilot row, but the responses vary substantially at fixed H.
